hook: Your country reached Mars on its very first try.
title: India Reached Mars on Its First Try
description:
ISRO's Mangalyaan reached Mars orbit in September 2014 on India's first attempt. That made India the first Asian country to reach Mars orbit. Part of the series: India In Space.

#Shorts #Mangalyaan #ISRO
